name: Barnard's Star
blurb: The fastest-moving star in the sky: 10.4″ per year. Between SPHEREx visits it steps about 1–2 pixels; against the 2010 WISE image it has leapt almost 3 arcminutes.
notes: Core saturated near 2 µm (detectors 2–4); detectors 5–6 are clean.
